set.signal: R&D and technology roadmap (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): H1 2026 R&D spend KRW 13,000M (4.52% of revenue). Ongoing programmes include a chiplet heterogeneous-integration high-performance AI semiconductor package (embedded Si bridge RDL interposer, since 2023-04), a 2.5D SiP integrating a processor with high-speed stacked memory (PIM), a petaflops-class compute plus GB-class DRAM PIM platform (since 2025-04), nPoP chip-last and a domestic backside-protection EMC film for system semiconductors; a FOWLP antenna-in-package development ran 2021-04 to 2023-12. The electronic-materials business supplies developer, etchant, photoresist and cleaner chemicals and focuses on materials used in the HBM process.

items.reason: FOWLP antenna-in-package project is listed as completed ('21.04 ~ '23.12), not ongoing; the 10% Deca Technologies stake / associate revenue is an ownership stake (skill section 2: no ownership stakes) and is dropped.
